newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 13.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 13.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon news report on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Centre Union party initiated discussions on the Siauliu free economic zone.

- The finance ministry intends to borrow $7 million from Hermis Bank to repay its loan to Vilnius Bank because of a lower interest rate offered. The sum is part of the Lietuvos Energija debt taken on by the government.
